entities.summary: Pietro Pileo di Prata (c.1330–1400) was an Italian bishop and cardinal. He was a significant diplomat and go-between in the affairs of his times, and was nicknamed the "cardinal with three hats", which he obtained successively from Urban VI, Clement VII, and Boniface IX.
